nodes.text: @EconomicTimes China is currently experiencing an outbreak of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV), which has been noted for causing symptoms similar to both the flu and COVID-19. Reports indicate that this virus is spreading rapidly across the country, particularly affecting children and the elderly.
